test_cases.title: Detail pages show their action buttons
acs: DERIVED: Customer, participant, contract, scheme and assessment pages show their buttons - 26 buttons (data/depth.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
Buttons are checked for presence only and are not clicked, except Cancel in TC-086.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 26 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx and click the links of the path in the current row.
steps.expected: The detail page opens with its heading.

steps.action: Look for the button named in the row.
steps.expected: The button is visible.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Repeat for every row.
steps.expected: Every button is shown.

steps.action: Do not click the button.
steps.expected: Nothing is changed.

test_cases.title: Cancel on a detail page returns to its list without saving
acs: DERIVED: Cancel on a detail page returns to the list it came from - 5 pages (data/depth.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
No field is changed before Cancel, so nothing is saved.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx and click the links of the path in the current row.
steps.expected: The detail page opens with its heading.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.expected: The browser leaves the form.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 matches the heading in the row.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look at the list.
steps.expected: The list is shown unchanged.
